newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Petromar Energy gets Singapore bunker license.
newsitem.headline: Petromar Energy gets Singapore bunker license.

text.p: Petromar Energy Resources Pte Ltd, the Singapore unit of leading Middle East bunker supplier, Metro Oil Corp, has started bunkering operations in Singapore, a company source said on Thursday.
Petromar received its bunker license from the Port Authority of Singapore in September and has already "done a handful of deliveries on our own," the source said.
"Right now we are in the trial stage. We dont' wish to rush in until all the infrastructure are in place," the source said.
Currently, Petromar is supplying bunker fuel to a few ships on spot basis using other companies' barges. It is also storing fuel oil on a spot basis in Singapore.

The source said the company has plans to buy barges and lease term storage space but these would not be done until the company is convinced that business in Singapore is viable. "Bunker business is very competitive. There are many many suppliers who have their own close customers," he said.
Parent company, Metro Oil has between 10 to 15 percent market share of the 12 million tonne a year Fujairah bunker market.
Metro Oil operates a 35,000-barrel-per-day crude distillation unit in Fujairah in United Arab Emirate and owns several bunker barges there.
